transcript.content: Hi, welcome in — I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess I'm here because... I'm just having trouble keeping things organized lately. 

There are just a lot of moving parts. Um, patent notes, team decisions at work... and some other things, like workshop prep and gallery deadlines. I just... I can’t seem to organize it all anymore. I end up just starting whatever is loudest, I guess, instead of... you know, what actually matters.
How long have you been noticing this trouble organizing things and figuring out what to focus on?

Um... I suppose it's been a real problem for... maybe a year and a month? Give or take. Things shifted at work after I... well, I got an award, and they pushed me into leading more of the coordination-heavy stuff. So... since then, mostly.
Over this past year, have you noticed feeling persistently sad, down, or losing interest and pleasure in things you used to enjoy?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think I feel sad. Just... behind on everything, I guess. But no.
Before this past year, going back to childhood or early adulthood, did you ever struggle with staying organized, focusing, or finishing tasks in the same way?

Um... I suppose so. If I really think back... yeah, grade school was kind of like that. Teachers used to write that I was bright, but... that I daydreamed. I'd lose my homework folders a lot. Or I'd actually finish an assignment and just... forget to hand it in. So... yeah, I guess it's been around since long before I was a teenager.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about things—like work, deadlines, or other areas of your life—even when there's no immediate problem, and do you have trouble controlling that worry?
No. I mean... I worry about work when I'm behind, obviously. But... not excessively, no. Just the normal amount when you're missing deadlines. I don't just sit around worrying for no reason.
Do you often feel restless, fidgety, or have trouble sitting still, or find yourself acting impulsively—like interrupting others or making quick decisions without thinking them through?

Um... I don't think I'm impulsive. But sitting still... yeah, I guess so. When I have these long design calls, I start feeling this... pressure building in my body. Like I just have to get up. I usually end up pacing around my office, or... just shifting from chair to chair. Even when I'm trying to look focused. So... yeah.
Outside of work, do you notice similar problems with organizing tasks, losing focus, or forgetting things—like at home, in relationships, or during your personal projects?

Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't... I haven't really noticed it as much at home. Mostly it's just the work stuff. I don't really have a lot of personal projects going on right now anyway, so... yeah. Just normal, I guess.
Do you ever lose track of everyday things like appointments, bills, or household tasks—say, forgetting to pay a bill on time or losing your keys—even when things are calm at home?
No... I don't think so. Most of my bills are just on autopay anyway, so... I don't really have to think about them. And I usually just leave my keys in my laptop bag. So... no, not really.
Do you notice your mind wandering or losing focus during things like conversations with friends, reading, or other activities you do for leisure?

Um... not really. I mean, I guess everyone's mind wanders a little sometimes, but... I haven't noticed it being a problem. I usually just watch TV or play video games when I'm not working, so... it's pretty easy to just zone out. It's fine.
You mentioned workshop prep and gallery deadlines earlier — when you are working on those personal projects, do you notice the same trouble organizing tasks or losing focus that you have at work?

Yeah... I suppose I did. Um... honestly, that's kind of what finally pushed me to make this appointment. I just... I can't seem to organize all the moving parts anymore. 

Between the patent notes, the workshop prep, those gallery deadlines... team decisions at work. It's just... I don't know. I end up just starting whatever is loudest, I guess. Instead of what actually matters. So... yeah.
Going back to when you were a kid, did your parents or family ever notice you having similar trouble focusing, staying organized, or finishing tasks at home—not just at school?

Um... I don't really remember much about how it was at home. But... looking back, I guess it was definitely there in grade school. 

My parents had these old report cards, and... the teachers would always write that I was bright, but that I daydreamed. A lot. I would actually finish my assignments and then just... forget to turn them in. Or I'd lose my homework folders entirely. That was... you know, long before I was a teenager. So... yeah. I guess it's been there a while.
Have friends or family ever mentioned that you seem distracted, forgetful, or disorganized when you're with them—like missing plans, forgetting things they told you, or losing track of conversations?

Um... no. Not really. I mean... I don't really have a lot of big social plans anyway, so... there isn't much to miss. And my family hasn't... they haven't brought anything like that up with me. So... no. I don't think so.
